metadata.title: Survey Consent and Ethics

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for ensuring surveys comply with ethical standards, informed consent, voluntariness, and participant protections.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Survey platforms and systems supporting consent capture, ethics enforcement, and participant rights.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Constraint pattern governing ethical commitments and informed consent within survey execution.

props.name: depends-on-pattern
props.remarks: Consent and ethics constraints apply to surveys governed by Survey Core.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Survey consent and ethics align with NIST SP 800-53 privacy and planning control families.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Ethical survey execution aligns with NIST Privacy Framework governance and individual participation principles.

metadata.remarks: Survey Consent and Ethics defines enforceable constraints ensuring surveys are conducted in accordance with informed consent, voluntariness, and ethical commitments. This pattern converts declared consent and ethics promises into system-enforced behavior rather than relying on policy alone.

components.title: Informed Consent Enforcement
components.description: Ensures participants are presented with clear, accurate, and complete consent information prior to survey participation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation or omission of consent information to improperly influence participation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: User confirmation and explicit acknowledgment enforce informed consent.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Individuals are provided with appropriate notice and consent information.
Policies define consent requirements for survey activities.

components.title: Voluntary Participation Assurance
components.description: Ensures participation in surveys is voluntary and free from coercion or undue influence.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of authority or trusted relationships to coerce survey participation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Process enforcement ensures refusal does not result in penalty or loss of benefit.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Individuals are permitted to decline participation without adverse consequence.

components.title: Purpose Limitation and Disclosure
components.description: Binds survey collection and use to the explicitly stated purpose communicated to participants.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Collection or reuse of survey information beyond the stated purpose.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Governance controls enforce alignment between declared purpose and data usage.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Survey activities are bounded by defined and approved purposes.

components.title: Ethics Oversight and Review
components.description: Ensures surveys requiring ethical review are approved and monitored by the appropriate authority.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Use of improperly authorized surveys to collect sensitive or personal information.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Formal approval workflows and reviews ensure ethical compliance.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Plans and approvals govern survey activities requiring ethical oversight.
